scope: Indivisible native XBEGIN/XABORT pair, x64 rel16/rel32 source provider and CPUID admission
integration_note: The final NeverC merge changes C++ placeholder translation and its documentation only. Git diff confirms no changes to LLVM, builtins, analysis/emission, headers, X86 tests, RTM fixtures or generated tables relative to the tested integration. Exact binary digests below identify the tested compiler.

emulator_correction.issue: -tsx overrides abort mode irrespective of option order. Abort mode without -tsx clears CPUID.RTM even when using the supplied CPUID definition.
emulator_correction.native_oracle: Require exact actual statuses for every imm8: (code << 24) | 1 in full mode, and 0, 2, 6 or 8 in forced mode. The explicit SDE-only fixture entry bypasses CPUID only for forced emulation.
emulator_correction.provider_oracle: Require CPUID.RTM in full mode and absence in forced mode. The unmodified production source must preserve every state byte when it declines.
